newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 6-month money market claims yield 1.629 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 6-month money market claims yield 1.629 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government six-month money market claims is 1.629 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.660 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on May 1, raised 985.9 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.183 percent.
The previous six-month issue, paid for on March 13, raised 799.25 million and was priced at 99.168 percent.
